strategy.summary: The strategy for Ryftborne: Shadows of the Void focuses on leveraging augmented reality (AR) to enhance user engagement through interactive gameplay and social sharing features. The project aims to comply with iOS and Android guidelines while adapting features to maintain core gameplay integrity. Additionally, the use of AI-generated content is integral to the promotional strategy and in-game assets.
